title: Down Payment, Interest, Fees and Rounding on Patient Payment Plans
content:
The price terms of every **Patient Payment Plans** term are set out in the grid below: the down payment due at acceptance, the interest and opening fee, the charge for paying off early, whether a prompt-pay discount can be taken on the plan balance, and how installments are rounded.

| Term | Down payment (percent of enrolled balance) | Annual interest (percent) | Setup fee (USD) | Early payoff charge (USD) | Prompt-pay discount on plan balance | Installment rounding |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3-Month Payment Plan | 0 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | Not available | Cent, last absorbs |
| 6-Month Payment Plan | 0 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | Not available | Cent, last absorbs |
| 9-Month Payment Plan | 0 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | Not available | Cent, last absorbs |
| 12-Month Payment Plan | 10 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | Not available | Cent, last absorbs |
| 18-Month Payment Plan | 10 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | Not available | Cent, last absorbs |
| 24-Month Extended Payment Plan | 15 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | Not available | Cent, last absorbs |

## Column definitions

- **Down payment** is the percent of the enrolled balance that is due at acceptance as a down payment; a figure of 0 means the term carries no down payment.
- **Annual interest** is the annual percent interest on the plan balance; 0 means the term is interest-free. All six terms are interest-free.
- **Setup fee** is the fee to open the plan; 0.00 means none. No term charges one.
- **Early payoff charge** is the charge for paying the plan off before its last installment; 0.00 means none. No term charges one.
- **Prompt-pay discount on plan balance** states whether a prompt-pay discount can be taken on a balance carried on the plan. It cannot on any term.
- **Installment rounding** — "cent, last absorbs" means installments are rounded to the cent and the last installment absorbs the rounding difference.

## Notes on the grid

- The terms that carry a down payment are the 12-Month Payment Plan and the 18-Month Payment Plan (10 percent each) and the 24-Month Extended Payment Plan (15 percent). The 3-, 6- and 9-month terms carry none.
- Hypothetical illustration of the rounding convention: a balance of 100.00 spread over 3 installments gives installments of 33.33 and 33.33, and a last installment of 33.34, which absorbs the one-cent difference.
